question: Can even immense material wealth justify giving away this Kaula teaching?
premises: Wealth could fill an ocean with jewels
Such wealth is compared to the teaching
inference: Even one able to fill the ocean with jewels should not exchange this teaching for wealth.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a sandhi fusion with unclear infinitive form
